reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific CrN nanoscale diffusion barrier at the Cr/Zr interface to solve the known Cr–Zr interdiffusion problem. None of the passages study or propose CrN as a diffusion barrier for Cr-coated Zr cladding; the closest ideas are NCD layers (P3, P6, P7, P8) or general nitride diffusion barriers in unrelated systems (P26, P28, P39). The mechanism of CrN blocking Cr and Zr diffusion is not stated in any passage, making the core idea a non-trivial new proposal.
